"Pop" and "gradient hero" aren't a spec, they're the default — the thing every landing page reaches for when nobody's decided anything. So before I spec that: what's this page actually for? Is it a launch/brand moment competing for attention, where going bold is the right call — or is it a standard product landing page, where a gradient hero would just be visual noise on top of whatever's already there?

Also, two things I don't have yet that I'd need before I ground this in anything real instead of guessing:

1. What's the existing design system/tokens for this page — colors, type scale, spacing? If there isn't one yet, I'll say so and start from the WCAG floor (4.5:1 body contrast, 3:1 for large text/controls, 16px minimum body, 44×44 targets) rather than inventing a new palette out of nowhere.
2. What's the actual goal of the page — sign-ups, a specific CTA, brand awareness? "Pop" means something different depending on what it's supposed to make people do.

And to be clear on the "ship it" part — I don't have a way to render a design or push anything live. What I can do is write a concrete spec (layout, hierarchy, exact tokens or values, states, contrast-checked) and hand it to Riley to build. If you want, tell me the goal and point me at whatever tokens/components already exist for this page, and I'll draft that spec.
